_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Factorio eggs in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Factorio
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Factorio's headless server, from factorio.com. It creates a map on first start and can update the server's mods from the mod portal when reinstalled.
startup: b=bin/x64/factorio; [ -x bin/arm64/factorio ] && b=bin/arm64/factorio; r=; [ "$b" = bin/x64/factorio ] && command -v box64 >/dev/null && r=box64; if [ ! -f "saves/{{SAVE_NAME}}.zip" ]; then $r $b --create "saves/{{SAVE_NAME}}.zip" --map-gen-settings data/map-gen-settings.json --map-settings data/map-settings.json || exit 1; fi; exec $r $b --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --server-settings data/server-settings.json --start-server "saves/{{SAVE_NAME}}.zip"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Factorio: downloads the headless server from factorio.com and checks it
# against Factorio's published SHA-256. Saves, mods and settings are never
# touched; the game's files are replaced only once the new ones are in.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

releases=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" https://factorio.com/api/latest-releases) ||
    fail "factorio.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
want="${FACTORIO_VERSION:-latest}"
case "$want" in
    ""|latest|stable) version=$(jq -r '.stable.headless' <<<"$releases") ;;
    experimental) version=$(jq -r '.experimental.headless' <<<"$releases") ;;
    *)
        [[ $want =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] ||
            fail "Version must be latest, experimental, or a Factorio version such as 2.0.72."
        version=$want ;;
esac

sums=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" https://factorio.com/download/sha256sums/ || true)
exists() { [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -A "$ua" "https://www.factorio.com/get-download/$version/headless/$1")" = 302 ]; }

# Factorio has an arm64 build from 2.1.18; older versions run through
# Box64 on arm64 (the runtime image starts them that way).
platform=linux64 file="factorio-headless_linux_$version.tar.xz" bin=x64
if [ "$(uname -m)" = aarch64 ] && exists linux-arm64; then
    platform=linux-arm64 file="factorio-headless_linux-arm64_$version.tar.xz" bin=arm64
fi
exists "$platform" || fail "Factorio has no version $version. Set Version to latest, experimental, or a released version such as $(jq -r '.stable.headless' <<<"$releases")."

if [ -x "bin/$bin/factorio" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $bin" ]; then
    echo "Factorio $version is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build"
    echo "Downloading Factorio $version ($bin)"
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$build/$file" "https://www.factorio.com/get-download/$version/headless/$platform"
    sum=$(awk -v f="$file" '$2 == f { print $1 }' <<<"$sums")
    if [ -n "$sum" ]; then
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "The download didn't match Factorio's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    else
        echo "Factorio publishes no checksum for $version, so the download wasn't checked."
    fi
    tar -xJf "$build/$file" -C "$build"
    # The game's files. Files the last version had and this one doesn't are
    # removed; the server's own files (settings, saves, mods) never are.
    (cd "$build/factorio" && find . -type f | sort) > "$build/files"
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        comm -23 <(sort .raptor-files) "$build/files" | while read -r f; do rm -f -- "$f"; rmdir -p --ignore-fail-on-non-empty "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null || true; done
    fi
    rm -rf bin
    cp -a "$build/factorio/." .
    mv -f "$build/files" .raptor-files
    echo "$version $bin" > .raptor-version
fi

for f in server-settings map-gen-settings map-settings; do
    [ -e "data/$f.json" ] || cp "data/$f.example.json" "data/$f.json"
done
mkdir -p saves mods

# Mods: updates every mod in mods/mod-list.json to its newest release for
# this Factorio version, from the mod portal (which needs a factorio.com
# account's username and token).
if [ "${UPDATE_MODS:-0}" = 1 ] && [ -f mods/mod-list.json ]; then
    if [ -z "${SERVER_USERNAME:-}" ] || [ -z "${SERVER_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        echo "Mods weren't updated: the mod portal needs your factorio.com username and token."
    else
        major=$(cut -d. -f1-2 <<<"$version")
        for mod in $(jq -r '.mods[] | select(.name | IN("base", "space-age", "quality", "elevated-rails") | not) | .name' mods/mod-list.json); do
            info=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "https://mods.factorio.com/api/mods/$(jq -rn --arg s "$mod" '$s|@uri')") || { echo "The mod portal has no mod $mod, so it was left as it is."; continue; }
            rel=$(jq -c --arg v "$major" '[.releases[] | select(.info_json.factorio_version == $v)] | last // empty' <<<"$info")
            [ -n "$rel" ] || { echo "$mod has no release for Factorio $major, so it was left as it is."; continue; }
            name=$(jq -r .file_name <<<"$rel")
            if [ -f "mods/$name" ]; then echo "$mod is up to date."; continue; fi
            curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "mods/$name.part" -G --data-urlencode "username=$SERVER_USERNAME" --data-urlencode "token=$SERVER_TOKEN" \
                "https://mods.factorio.com$(jq -r .download_url <<<"$rel")" || { rm -f "mods/$name.part"; echo "$mod couldn't be downloaded: check the username and token."; continue; }
            if [ "$(sha1sum "mods/$name.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$(jq -r .sha1 <<<"$rel")" ]; then
                rm -f "mods/$name.part"; echo "$mod's download didn't match the mod portal's checksum, so it was left as it is."; continue
            fi
            find mods -maxdepth 1 -name "${mod}_*.zip" ! -name "$name" -delete
            mv -f "mods/$name.part" "mods/$name"
            echo "Updated $mod to $(jq -r .version <<<"$rel")."
        done
    fi
fi
echo "Installed Factorio $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Factorio version, such as 2.0.72, latest for the newest stable one, or experimental. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Save name
variables.description: The save in the saves folder to run, without .zip. A new map is created when it doesn't exist.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description shown in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be online at once, or 0 for no limit.

variables.name: Factorio username
variables.description: Your factorio.com username, for a public server and for mod updates.

variables.name: Factorio token
variables.description: Your factorio.com token (on your profile page), for a public server and for mod updates.

variables.name: Update mods on reinstall
variables.description: Update every mod in mods/mod-list.json to its newest release when the server is reinstalled. Needs your username and token.

variables.name: AFK kick
variables.description: Minutes before an idle player is kicked, or 0 to never kick.
